_meta.purpose: On-hand inventory of flock inputs — anthelmintics, vaccines, feed, minerals — with quantity, lot, expiry, and reorder level. Consumed read-only by scripts/input_inventory.py to flag expired/expiring stock and items below reorder level.
_meta.owned_by: operator — quantities, expiries, lots, and reorder levels are entered by hand as stock is bought and used. This tool authors none of them.
_meta.why_expiry_matters: Expired dewormer is not just wasted money — a degraded anthelmintic under-doses, and under-dosing selects for resistance. Expired vaccine may not protect. Track expiry as carefully as the FECRT tracks efficacy.
_meta.seed_note: The anthelmintic/vaccine/support items below are SEEDED from the drugs this flock has actually used (treatment history), so the starting inventory matches real use. quantity/expiry/lot/reorder_level are null until the operator enters them; a null quantity reads as 'not counted', never as 'zero on hand'.
_meta.quantity_shape: quantity is the MCS-12 shape {value, unit} (e.g. {"value": 500, "unit": "mL"}); unit is free but volume/mass units convert.

schema.name: product/brand name
schema.category: anthelmintic | vaccine | antibiotic | mineral | feed | supportive | other
schema.quantity: {value, unit} on hand, or null if not counted
schema.reorder_level: {value, unit} below which to reorder, or null
